description: This is a benchmarking script for the AgentField Python SDK, measuring agent initialization, handler registration, memory footprint, cold start time, and request latency.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Data class for statistical metrics including mean, stddev, min, max, and percentiles.

methods.name: calculate_stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics from a list of float data points.

methods.name: benchmark_agent_init
methods.description: Measures the time taken to initialize the Agent without handlers.

methods.name: benchmark_handler_registration
methods.description: Measures the time to register handlers with an existing Agent.

methods.name: benchmark_agent_memory
methods.description: Measures memory footprint of the Agent without handlers.

methods.name: benchmark_handler_memory
methods.description: Measures memory footprint of handlers only, excluding Agent overhead.

methods.name: benchmark_cold_start
methods.description: Measures total time for agent startup and first handler registration (cold start).

methods.name: benchmark_request_processing
methods.description: Measures latency of processing requests via handlers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating all benchmarks and outputting results.
